segments.segment_summary: An introduction to a wheat harvest, showing aerial views of the farm landscape, a combine unloading grain into a truck, and the combine at work in the field.

key_moments.caption: Aerial view of a truck next to a harvested wheat field with hay bales, panning to show a distant farm.
A John Deere combine harvester unloads harvested grain into a large red and white truck.
A combine harvester drives through the golden wheat field, kicking up dust.
A person walks toward the truck as a combine harvester approaches from behind.

segments.segment_summary: An aerial montage showcases the vast and varied landscape of the farm, flying over harvested fields, golden wheat fields, and green crops with irrigation systems.

key_moments.caption: An aerial shot flies over a vast harvested field with neat rows of stubble.
The camera pans across a landscape with both golden wheat fields and green crop fields divided by a road.
An aerial view shows multiple combines and tractors working in a distant field.
A long irrigation system is seen in a green field next to a golden wheat field.

segments.segment_summary: Aerial footage follows combine harvesters as they actively cut through a golden wheat field, showing the process of harvesting from various angles and concluding with a view of the expansive, partially harvested landscape.

key_moments.caption: An aerial shot follows two combine harvesters as they move through a field, cutting the wheat.
The camera flies over a combine harvester working near a grassy patch with two hay bales.
A close aerial shot tracks a combine from behind as it cuts a path through the wheat.
High aerial view showing two combines harvesting different sections of a large field.
